watersourcemod.config.subtitle: Client-only accessibility overlay; settings are saved locally
watersourcemod.config.show_sources.toolt: Mark full source water blocks with the source color.
watersourcemod.config.show_flowing.toolt: Mark non-source water states with the flowing-water color.
watersourcemod.config.include_waterlogge: Include source water inside blocks with the waterlogged property. Disable this to focus on free-standing source blocks.
watersourcemod.config.through_walls.tool: Allows markers to render through terrain. Make sure this is allowed on the server you play on. #fairplay
watersourcemod.config.show_labels.toolti: Show SOURCE and FLOWING labels in the small overlay status panel.
watersourcemod.config.show_status_hud.to: Show scan progress and source/flowing marker counts while the overlay is enabled.
watersourcemod.config.pulse.tooltip: Gently animate marker brightness to make the overlay easier to notice.
watersourcemod.config.marker_style.toolt: Choose the shape used for source and flowing-water markers.
watersourcemod.config.chunk_radius.toolt: Chunks outward from your current chunk. Radius 1 is 3x3; radius 2 is 5x5. Only chunks already loaded by the client are scanned.
watersourcemod.config.source_color.toolt: High-contrast color used for source-water markers.
watersourcemod.config.flowing_color.tool: High-contrast color used for non-source flowing-water markers.
watersourcemod.config.opacity.tooltip: Slide left to right to control marker transparency. Higher values are easier to see but more visually prominent.
Controls the dark contrast border around each marker.
watersourcemod.config.max_markers.toolti: Maximum markers retained per scan. Sources are kept before flowing markers when the limit is reached.
watersourcemod.config.reset.tooltip: Restore the safe default settings, including overlay off at startup and through-wall rendering off.
watersourcemod.hud.title: Water Source
